mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate consistently compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% (the current level), or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in economic contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in housing starts signals a deepening economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises and HOUST falls, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts activity signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1000 thousand units, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 signals weakening manufacturing activity and impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in reduced corporate output and profits.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, high retail sales (RSAFS) signal excessive consumer spending and impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced future growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS exceeds 390000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and rise in unemployment rate signals aggressive monetary easing in response to a deepening recession, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates severe economic damage and reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.
